lea.text: Serra's Realm is corrupted by Phyrexian black mana, which drives away Serra and leads to Radiant's coup, while Urza evacuates some angels to Dominaria.

leb.text: Serra creates Serra's Realm hoping to build a haven where suffering could be avoided forever.
After Urza leaves, the Phyrexians attack, and though they are repelled their black mana taints the Realm, so Serra proposes an exodus and flees.
